items.title: Concern as private health giant wins access to public emergency patients
items.description: A trial to ease pressure on a public emergency department has raised concerns a multi-million-dollar company is getting a special deal.

items.title: Lives would have been saved if armed Jewish group were at Bondi, Lowy says
items.description: Prominent Jewish businessman and philanthropist Steven Lowy says the "tragedy would have been far smaller" if armed security were at the event targeted in the Bondi Beach shooting.

items.title: Ernst and Young staff allegedly access Albanese's banking information
items.description: Two Ernst and Young employees allegedly accessed Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's personal banking information while working for the accounting firm at the Commonwealth Bank.

items.title: Live: Netherlands battle Morocco, Paraguay shocks Germany in shootout
items.description: The Netherlands and Morocco meet in a tantalising round of 32 clash after Paraguay knocks Germany out of the 2026 World Cup in a penalty shootout. Follow live.

items.title: How a punt on a trial in Italy created the Socceroos' next star
items.description: Cristian Volpato was rejected by two Australian soccer academies. His family dropped everything to go for a trial in Italy. That was the making of Australia's next star.

items.title: Private equity boss banned from driving over 'absolute shocker' crash
items.description: Private equity baron Joel Thickins has had his license suspended after pleading guilty to negligent driving while under the influence of alcohol and refusing a breath test.

items.title: 'MrBeast model': Stefanovic's numbers reveal his broader strategy
items.description: Why is the former king of Australian breakfast television trading studio lights for ring lights?

items.title: Multiple injuries, driver unaccounted for in truck-stop crash inferno
items.description: Explosions, multiple injuries and up to seven semi-trailers destroyed as a truck collision sets off a fiery chain of events on the Hume Highway.

items.title: 'Systemic racism' tip of the iceberg in buried reef authority review
items.description: The damning results of a review into the agency tasked with managing the Great Barrier Reef, an area bigger than New Zealand and home to 70 traditional owner groups, has never before seen the light of day.

items.title: ACCC sues Amazon over introduction of ads on Prime
items.description: The consumer watchdog is suing Amazon over alleged unfair contract terms for its Prime streaming service.

items.title: Live: Treasurer 'willing to engage' on super for under-18s
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers says he's open to discussing a guarantee for superannuation to be paid for teenage workers but stresses that's not the government's focus at the moment. Follow live.

items.title: 'We don't fully understand': The footy risk few parents grasp
items.description: Contact is an essential part of footy, but there is growing evidence it can also be a grave threat to the health and welfare of its players. Experts say the AFL should be acting now to protect current and future players.

items.title: Seven Australians in Venezuela request government help as quake toll climbs
items.description: Australia is providing "consular assistance" to seven people after Venezuela's two earthquakes, Foreign Affairs Minister Penny Wong confirms.

items.title: Live: ASX trading sideways, Wall Street jumps as AI-related stocks rebound
items.description: The Australian share market has started its day relatively flat despite a rebound in oil prices ahead of the next round of US-Iran peace talks. On Wall Street, the Dow Jones Industrial Average hit a record high. Follow live.

items.title: More Australians are doing their own tax returns and making these mistakes
items.description: With side hustles, working from home, crypto investments, renting out rooms and receiving income through digital platforms or apps, experts say people are at greater risk of making errors with their tax.

items.title: Don't ask me what's culturally appropriate, I don't know either
items.description: After sending out invitations to a belated elopement party, I was suddenly fielding calls from friends who wanted to wear saris but were worried that it might be disrespectful.

items.title: BalletTok, blackface and nudes: Inside the world of professional ballet
items.description: Ariane Beeston, the author of an acclaimed memoir detailing her experience with postpartum psychosis, has penned her first work of fiction, Don't Forget to Smile.

items.title: Midwife hit with $70,000 foreign investment tax after moving to Australia
items.description: A British midwife who migrated to Australia to work at a regional hospital during statewide staff shortages is calling for changes to the law after being slugged $70,000 by state and federal authorities for the purchase of her home.

items.title: Major coal mine to close in 2028 with hundreds of jobs lost, union says
items.description: The Mining and Energy Union says 60 jobs at Yancoal's Ashton underground coal mine will be cut soon, with a full closure expected by early 2028.

items.title: What to know about the government's proposed university reforms
items.description: The government will spend an extra $3.6 billion over a decade on new university places, but some are warning the money could be wasted.

items.title: New fellowship for mid-career journalists honours Judith Whelan
items.description: The ABC, The Sydney Morning Herald and Sydney University have created a new fellowship to honour the late Judith Whelan, a trailblazing leader in media.

items.title: Sons remember 'loving' mum after Airbnb guest found guilty of killing her
items.description: Maree Vermont's sons say they never thought hosting Airbnb guests would be dangerous for their mother, who was proud of the home she had built.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz strikes likely to disrupt shipping again
items.description: Fresh attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz have exposed the fragility of the 60-day ceasefire deal between the US and Iran, which was meant to allow ships to transit through the waterway again.

items.title: Social media giants face fines for failing to hand over documents
items.description: Labor wants to double the fines for tech giants who refuse to hand over documents that could prove they are failing to enforce Australia’s social media age ban.

items.title: Ill-fated midnight mountain walk in freezing conditions led to 12-day search
items.description: The NSW coroner praises emergency services for "persistence" during the 12-day search for a hiker who set off on an ill-fated midnight mountain walk in sub-zero temperatures while wearing sandals.
